items.promptEn:
① My aunt is living ________ Mexico.
② Birds are singing ________ the sky.
③ There is a fan ________ the ceiling.
④ Let's meet ________ front of the theater.
⑤ I found my cell phone ________ my bag.
choices: There is a fan ________ the ceiling.
Let's meet ________ front of the theater.
I found my cell phone ________ my bag.

Nari and I will meet (A) ________ the bus stop (B) ________ the afternoon.

items.promptEn:
A: What day do you take piano lessons?
B: <u>나는 화요일에 피아노 레슨을 받아.</u>
accept: I take piano lessons on Tuesdays.
I take piano lessons on Tuesday.

choices: I watched TV for an hour after dinner.
I watched TV for an hour before dinner.
I watched TV during an hour after dinner.
I watched TV during an hour until dinner.
I watched TV during an hour before dinner.

ⓐ He stayed up until 11:00 p.m.
ⓑ I lived on Busan two years ago.
ⓒ I do yoga for thirty minutes a day.
ⓓ Our graduation day is at February 15.
ⓔ Sue doesn't get up early on Sundays.

② I went to the nail shop with my mom.
③ The magician turned a flower in a bird.
④ I finished my math project thanks in Seho.
⑤ New York City is famous on the Statue of Liberty.

내가 그를 보았을 때, 그의 눈은 눈물로 가득 차 있었다. (full)
→ When I saw him, his eyes ________________________________ tears.
accept: When I saw him, his eyes were full of tears.

ⓒ This watch is different ________ mine.

2. There is a blue car ________ the garage.
3. There is a fence ________ the backyard.
